serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Infotek Online Services for US Government
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Infotek Online Services for US Government is a secure, multi-tenant cloud service offering (CSO) that provides Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) capabilities within a FedRAMP Moderate impact boundary. The CSO supports U.S. government agencies by delivering hosted application environments, centralized logging, encrypted data storage, and secure networking components that are managed within an Azure Government environment.

The service includes:

Virtualized compute instances and managed storage resources

Web application hosting and backend API services

Secure access via Azure Front Door, load balancing, and private link configurations

Role-based access control (RBAC) and identity federation with Entra ID

Centralized log collection, analytics, and incident alerting via Microsoft Sentinel

Vulnerability scanning and patch management integration with Qualys

Managed database services (Azure SQL) with Always Encrypted and CMK integration

System backup and disaster recovery via Azure Backup and Site Recovery

Endpoint protection with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

Full audit logging, data encryption in transit and at rest, and customer-managed key support

All components within the boundary are continuously monitored, operated, and maintained in compliance with FedRAMP Moderate controls as documented in the System Security Plan (SSP).
